highlights.name: Universal's Islands of Adventure
highlights.description: Universal Islands of Adventure, commonly shortened to Islands of Adventure, is a theme park in Orlando, Florida, United States.

highlights.name: Epcot
highlights.description: EPCOT is a theme park at Walt Disney World Resort in Bay Lake, Florida. Epcot is owned and operated by the Walt Disney Company through its Disney Experiences division.

highlights.name: Magic Kingdom
highlights.description: Magic Kingdom Park, or simply Magic Kingdom, is a theme park at Walt Disney World Resort in Bay Lake, Florida, near Orlando.

highlights.name: Disney's Hollywood Studios
highlights.description: Disney's Hollywood Studios is a theme park at the Walt Disney World Resort in Bay Lake, Florida, near Orlando. It is owned and operated by the Walt Disney Company through its Experiences division.

highlights.name: Holy Land Experience
highlights.description: The Holy Land Experience was a Christian amusement park in Orlando, Florida and registered non-profit corporation. HLE conducted weekly church services and bible studies for the general public.

highlights.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom
highlights.description: Disney's Animal Kingdom Theme Park is a zoological theme park at Walt Disney World Resort in Bay Lake, Florida, near Orlando.

highlights.name: Icon Park
highlights.description: Icon Park, originally named I-Drive 360 until 2018, is an entertainment complex in Orlando, Florida, that has been operating since 2015.

highlights.name: Harry P. Leu Gardens
highlights.description: The Harry P. Leu Gardens are semi-tropical and tropical gardens at 1920 North Forest Avenue in Orlando, Florida, United States.

highlights.name: Orlando Museum of Art
highlights.description: The Orlando Museum of Art is a 501 3 not-for-profit organization directly serving greater Orlando, Orange County and Central Florida. The museum was founded in 1924 by a group of art enthusiasts.

highlights.name: Lake Eola Park
highlights.description: Lake Eola Park is a public park located in Downtown Orlando, Florida. Lake Eola is the main feature of the park.

highlights.name: Dezerland Park Orlando
highlights.description: Dezerland Park Orlando is an enclosed family entertainment center located on International Drive in Orlando, Florida, United States. The 850,000-square-foot complex, opened in 2020, is operated by real estate developer Michael Dezer.
